title: Rules for the night lift attendant 🛗
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: You have been hired as the night lift attendant at an empty office tower.

scenes.narration: You have been hired as the night lift attendant at an empty office tower. Read the rules before your first shift.
Rule one. The building is empty after ten. Your only job is to keep lift two in service. Lift one is out of order. Never ride it.
Rule two. If lift two stops on a floor you did not press, do not open the doors. Wait for it to move on.
Rule three. If you hear someone call your name from the shaft, answer once, quietly, and only with your first name.
Rule four. Lift buttons above the fortieth floor are painted over. If one is lit, you did not see it.
Rule five. A man in a grey coat may ask for the forty first floor. He is allowed to ride. He is the only one who is.
Tonight lift two stopped on forty one. The doors stayed shut. Through the gap I heard my own voice, calling me by my full name.
Rule six was missing from your sheet. I found it on the back, in my handwriting. Rule six. The attendant on duty is always the one in the grey coat.
So tell me. Do you open the doors, or ride up alone?
